_comment: Thresholds and delivery for the GSC monitor. Edited here and committed -- there is no server to save settings to.

email._note: Password comes from the SMTP_PASSWORD secret, never this file. Zoho SMTP with an app-specific password is the only delivery path that works from Actions -- Catalyst Mail refuses to send from zohocorp.com.

windows._note: Current N days vs the immediately preceding N days. 7 keeps day-of-week composition identical on both sides, which a 'vs last month' comparison does not.

decay._note: Last 28 days vs the 28 days ending a quarter ago. A week-on-week check cannot see a slow bleed: blogs.manageengine.com fell from 7,684 clicks/month to 0 across nine months without any single week breaching a threshold.

churn._window_note: Its own window, longer than the 7-day drop comparison. A query losing every impression is a slower signal: measured on this data, a 7-day window found zero queries that vanished with 10+ prior clicks, while 28 days found 14 missing and 36 new.
churn._note: Queries that vanished entirely, and ones that appeared from nothing. A drop check cannot see either: a query with no rows this period has nothing to compare against, which is why a total loss is the easiest kind to miss.

thresholds._note: Minimum absolute movements exist because a percentage on a small base is noise: a page going 3 clicks -> 1 is a 67% drop and means nothing.

pipeline._note: Search Console finalises on a ~3 day lag and the loader targets today-3, so 5 allows one missed run before shouting.
pipeline._gap_note: Missing days are only a fault if the property had traffic to miss. A near-dead property genuinely returns zero rows for many days -- re-probed against the API to confirm. Below this median daily row count, gaps are not reported; the decay check raises the real problem instead.

payload._drilldown_note: Expanding a page shows its top 10 queries; expanding a query shows the top 10 pages ranking for it. The Explore tab drills live instead, so its drilldown honours whatever date range and country/device filters are active.

properties._note: site_urls listed in exclude are still loaded to BigQuery but hidden from the dashboard and never alerted on.
